_doc: Detection benchmark corpus (v07 T0). Expectations are GROUND TRUTH,
authored from repo inspection — never from scanner output. If a run
diverges, that is a finding to investigate, not an expectation to edit.
Editing an expectation requires citing the repo evidence that justifies
kind=git entries are pinned to a commit SHA (repos drift; the replay
experiments taught this). kind=fixture entries live under fixtures/ and
isolate exactly one known gap each.
xfail=true: the gap is known (v07 §2) and the entry documents it. An
xfail that PASSES fails the run — promote it to a real expectation.

entries.name: deepface
entries.ground_truth: Face recognition/attribute library. `from deepface.commons import ...` at deepface/DeepFace.py:20; ethnicity-confidence fields near DeepFace.py:262. deepface is in AI-001's import patterns.

entries.name: face_recognition
entries.ground_truth: The canonical face-recognition package; imports its own API throughout (e.g. face_recognition/face_detection_cli.py:6).

entries.name: openai-quickstart
entries.ground_truth: Official OpenAI example app; `import openai` in examples/chat-basic/app.py:9.

entries.name: requests
entries.ground_truth: HTTP client library; no AI/ML libraries anywhere. False-positive control: ANY finding here is a precision defect.

entries.name: flask
entries.ground_truth: Web framework; no AI/ML libraries. Second FP control — its tutorial code has user/email/password fields, which must NOT read as an AI system handling PII.

entries.name: modern_sdk
entries.ground_truth: `from anthropic import Anthropic` + `from deepface import DeepFace` — the exact import style DL-027 was blind to. Guards that fix permanently.

entries.name: notebook_only
entries.ground_truth: analysis.ipynb imports deepface and openai in a code cell. Detected via notebook extraction (v07 T1.2, promoted from xfail 2026-08-31). Evidence lines refer to the extracted code-cell stream per source_reader.py. AI-flagged repo without model/data cards, so AI-004/AI-006 also fire.

entries.name: manifest_only
entries.ground_truth: requirements.txt pins deepface==0.0.93; plugin_loader.py imports it only via importlib.import_module. Detected via manifest cross-reference (v07 T1.1, promoted from xfail 2026-08-31). No model/data card exists, so AI-004/AI-006 fire on the AI-flagged repo.

entries.name: raw_endpoint
entries.ground_truth: client.py POSTs to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions via requests — shadow-AI usage with no SDK import anywhere. Detectable only through the endpoint string signal (v07 T1.3).
